title: CrewMemoryFact
description: A fact a crew remembers, in the kubemoot_crew_memory bucket, key <namespace>.<crew>.<topic>.<key>, with default as the crew of a crewless agent.

learnedBy.description: The agent that learned it, or dashboard.

learnedAt.description: When it was learned, RFC 3339 in UTC.

usedAt.description: When it was last used, RFC 3339 in UTC. Older entries lack it; readers use learnedAt.
